segments.text: Hello, Grandpa. It's Daniel. I'm
using a borrowed phone because mine broke this morning. Can
you hear me properly? Yes,
I can hear you. What happened to your phone? I
dropped it while
I was out. I'm at a garage now and there's a problem with
the bill. Are you
alright? Should
call mom? I need you to withdraw 2000
francs now and give the cash to a friend. I'll send
to your house, okay? Please do it before anyone
finds out. Wait
a moment. I need to understand
what you're asking.
But after noon, this is Mr. Adams.
I'm calling about an incident involving your daughter this morning.
An incident?
Is she hurt?
She has been arrested after a traffic accident.
To release her today, you must bring 5,000 francs
in cash to our career outside the station.
Do not contact anyone else.
Can I speak to her first?
There's no time for that.
But the career is waiting and she will stay in custody
if you delay.
I haven't agreed to anything, please explain who
you work for.
Good evening. This is Inspector Lewis. We
are contacting residents in your area about
a recent series of burglaries. I
see. Has something happened in my street? We
believe
some houses nearby may be targeted. Do you keep
any jewelry or cash at home? I
have a few
things? Why do you ask? Put
your jewelry and cash into a bag. An
undercover officer
will collect it tonight for safekeeping. Don't
tell your neighbors or call the local station
because that could expose the operation. I'd
like to verify this before anyone comes to my door.
Hello, this is Rachel from the Account Security Team
at Citibank.
We are checking a recent card purchase.
Which purchase are you calling about?
A payment of 3000 and 20 francs
at an electronics shop.
Did you make that purchase today?
No, I haven't used my card today.
To cancel it, read me the 6th digit login code
that has just arrived on your phone.
I need that code before I can block the payment.
The message says to not share it.
Why do you need it?
Hello, I'm calling from the computer service team.
Are you near your laptop at the moment?
Yes, but I haven't requested any support. We've
detected a virus on it. Install a remote control
program,
give me the access code, and open your online banking
so I can check whether the virus has
reached your account.
Why would you need to see my banking? The
security check won't work unless I can control the computer
while you sign in.
I'm going to stop and check this first.
Good afternoon. This is the customer refund
department. We have a refund connected to your
computer service contract. How
much is the refund supposed to be? 200
francs. To release it,
tell me your online banking password and the verification
code on your phone. I will log in
and put the refunds straight into your account. Can't
you refund the card I originally used?
A refund system needs those log-in details. Please
read them to me before the session
expires. I'm not going to give you
access to my account.
Hello, this is Mia from the Dental Practice. I'm
calling about your checkup next Tuesday
at 10 in the morning. Hello, yes,
I have that in my calendar. The dentist
has a meeting
that morning. Would you be able to come at 11
instead? The appointment will still take
about half an hour. 11 works
for me. Do I need to bring anything?
Please bring your usual insurance
card when you come to reception. We don't need any
details over the phone today. Great, thanks
for letting me know. I'll see you on Tuesday.
Hi Dad, it's Emma, the train has been cancelled
and I'm waiting at the station.
Could you pick me up when you finish work?
Of course, which entrance are you waiting at?
The one beside the bakery, it's raining quite hard,
so I'm standing outside for now.
There's no rush, I have a book with me.
I can be there in about 20 minutes.
Would you like me to bring your coat?
Yes, please.
It's on the chair by the kitchen door.
I'll watch for your car.
All right, stay inside and I'll call when I arrive.
Hello, this is the Town Library.
The book you reserved last week has arrived, and
I'm calling to let you know it's ready.
Lovely.
How long can you hold it for me?
We'll keep it at the front desk until such Saturday.
Bring your library card when you come in and we'll check it out
for you.
I can visit tomorrow afternoon, or you're open after
four?
Yes.
We close at seven on Thursdays.
The entrance on the square is open as usual.
Thank you.
I'll pick it up tomorrow.
Hello, this is Claire from the city bank.
We notice an unusual card payment and if temporarily
frozen the card as a precaution.
I haven't bought anything today.
What should I do?
Please open your usual banking app and review
the payment there or call the number printed
on your card.
You can also visit your branch.
Do you need my password or verification code?
No, keep both private.
I'm only notifying you.
You do not need to give me any account details or move
any money on this call.
Thank you.
I'll contact the bank using the number on my card.
Hi mom, it's Laura.
You mentioned getting a strange bank call yesterday and
I wanted to check you're all right.
I'm fine, but the caller sound is very convincing.
They said something about the security code.
Please don't share a banking password or a one-time
code with anyone who calls you.
If you're worried, hang up and contact your
bank using your card or the official app.
I ended the call without telling them anything.
Good. We can look through your account together
when I visit.
But keep your login details to yourself.
Thank you. I'll see you tomorrow.
Hello, this is Sam from the Internet Help
Desk, returning the support request you opened
about your connection dropping.
Thanks for calling back, it has stopped working twice
this afternoon.
Let's try restarting the router.
Unplug its power cable, wait 20 seconds
and plug it back in.
I'll stay on the line while the lights come back.
Do you need the Wi-Fi password from the label?
No, keep that private, just tell me whether
the Internet light turns green again.
It's green now, and the page on my laptop is loading.

limitations: Authored, assistant-reviewed cases; not independent human validation or real-world accuracy.
Repeated runs are regression checks; do not train or tune on these cases.
Twelve audio cases are a subset, not twelve additional independent conversations.
Original robocalls are unlabelled exploratory checks, excluded from accuracy counts.
Audio times locate speech, not wall-clock latency or smartphone performance.

audio_summary.note: Flagged means a warning occurred somewhere in the call, not necessarily at the right point.
